meta.requirement: Explore Starfell Lake (40%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: The Moving Box
start.text: ''Some rough-looking men are sitting around a roped crate on the shore, and the crate slides sideways on its own.''

Hey__what_s_in_the_box_.text: Ketch: Nothing. None of your business.

Come_on__what_s_in_it_.text: Ketch: Why do you care what's in it? It's a normal box.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Stop the Treasure Hoarders at Starfell Lake

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Fight the Treasure Hoarders. Defeat 1 [[Treasure Hoarder Cryo Potioneer]], 1 [[Treasure Hoarder Marksman]], and 1 [[Treasure Hoarder Crusher]]

____The_Moving_Box__Walked_Away.title: Walked Away
____The_Moving_Box__Walked_Away.text: ''You keep walking and the thumping fades out behind you.''

____The_Moving_Box__Walked_Away_.title: Walked Away
____The_Moving_Box__Walked_Away_.text: ''You back off and they watch you the whole way.''

Fight_the_Treasure_Hoarders.text:
''The crate is still thumping, and a small voice is yelling from inside.''

Voice: Hello?? Is it the mean men?? Hello!!

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Open the crate the Treasure Hoarders were guarding

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Open the crate

Open_the_crate.text:
''You cut the rope and lift the lid, and a boy with a gag around his neck and his wrists tied is squinting up at you.''

Tobi: Thank you thank you, I couldn't even yell, they put me in here and it was so dark.

Where_do_you_live_.text: Tobi: Falcon Coast! My dad sells fish by the pier, can we go, please?

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Take Tobi home to Falcon Coast

continues.label: Go to Falcon Coast (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Find Tobi's dad

Find_Tobi_s_dad.text:
Tobi: DAD!!

''Joren drops his cart handle and Tobi runs straight into him.''

____The_Moving_Box__Boy_Returned_Home.title: Boy Returned Home
____The_Moving_Box__Boy_Returned_Home.text:
Joren: I looked all night... I didn't know where to... ''takes his cap off''

Joren: I owe you. It's a hundred silver, I know it's not much.
